# Yusef Syed

> Yusef Syed is a software engineer working on AI agent security and evals. He is the founder of Scopehaven and a first-year student at the University of Toronto, based in Toronto, Ontario. He builds tools that check what an AI agent actually did, not what it said. He is looking for a full-time startup role from January 2027 anywhere in the U.S. (San Francisco, New York or remote) and is also open to Summer 2027 internships. He is a U.S. and Canadian citizen and needs no visa sponsorship.

Quick facts:

- Role: Founder & Software Engineer, AI Security at Scopehaven (solo, started October 2026)
- Focus: AI agent security, LLM evaluation (evals), AI red teaming, prompt injection
- Roles sought: security engineer, evals engineer, AI red team engineer or AI safety research engineer
- Location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada
- Work authorization: U.S. and Canadian citizen; no visa sponsorship needed
- Available from: January 2027 (full-time startup role in the U.S.); also open to Summer 2027 internships
- Education: University of Toronto, B.Sc., Mathematical & Physical Sciences, intended Math and CS double major, expected May 2030
- Contact: yusefmsyed@gmail.com

## Projects

- [ToolEffectBench](https://github.com/YusefSyed/tool-effect-bench): benchmark that scores prompt injection on tool-using LLM agents by what the agent changed in a network-less sandbox's database, not by its transcript. 17 models, 5,628 scored runs. Python, Inspect AI, Docker.
- [Scopehaven](https://scopehaven.dev): CLI and GitHub Action that catches an AI agent acting on the wrong account, tenant or refund, judged from the app's own records.
- [Scopehaven open edition](https://github.com/YusefSyed/scopehaven-oss): Node.js, Apache-2.0, v0.7.0. On its own synthetic test app the vulnerable build fails 26 of 44 checks and the repaired build passes 44 of 44.
- [effect-tracer](https://github.com/YusefSyed/effect-tracer): signs a process tree's file writes, connects, DNS and execs into a hash chain. Caught 19 of 20 seeded bypasses at 1.1 to 1.9x overhead. Rust, Linux ptrace/seccomp, Ed25519.
- [Agent Eval Mutation Lab](https://github.com/YusefSyed/agent-eval-mutation-lab): 624-trial study across two local models; five of six validity gates failed, so improvement claims were withheld. Python.
- [Providence](https://devpost.com/software/providence-tn6m4h): 1st Place, Aramco Americas Best Beginner Hack, Hack the North 2026. Swift, team of four.

## Papers

- [ToolEffectBench: Scoring Prompt Injection on Tool-Using Agents from Persisted State](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23966727): Yusef Syed, sole author, Zenodo, 2026. arXiv submission in review.
- [Checks for Checkers: Sealed Paired Comparisons of AI Agent Verification Tools](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23966747): Yusef Syed, sole author, Zenodo, 2026. Blind, timestamped comparison on 96 planted-defect and 96 clean cases; published as a null result.

## Open source

17 merged pull requests in 8 outside repos.

- [google/adk-python #8074](https://github.com/google/adk-python/pull/8074): Google ADK. Fixed an eval that scored a matching no-argument tool call as a miss. Merged through Google's internal import as commit 6e448cf.
- [microsoft/PyRIT #2537](https://github.com/microsoft/PyRIT/pull/2537): Microsoft PyRIT. Extended the package-hallucination scenario to Dart, Perl and Raku, with tests.
- [microsoft/agent-lightning #584](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-lightning/pull/584): Microsoft Agent Lightning. One of four reliability fixes.
- [wandb/rai-toolkit #106](https://github.com/wandb/rai-toolkit/pull/106): W&B RAI Toolkit. One of five evaluation fixes.
- [apache/arrow #51160](https://github.com/apache/arrow/pull/51160): Apache Arrow. Four PyArrow slice APIs accept Arrow integer scalars.
- [meridianlabs-ai/inspect_scout #586](https://github.com/meridianlabs-ai/inspect_scout/pull/586): Inspect Scout. One of three merged pull requests.
- [kornia/kornia #4185](https://github.com/kornia/kornia/pull/4185): Kornia. One merged pull request.
- [crescerelabs/sentience-governor #25](https://github.com/crescerelabs/sentience-governor/pull/25): Sentience Governor. One merged pull request.
